name: solo-founder-skills-marketplace
description: Expert skills for non-technical founders building SaaS with AI tools, in 10 focused plugins. Install sf-core first.

plugins.name: sf-core
plugins.description: Start here. Orientation and routing for non-technical founders building SaaS with AI tools: where to start, what to do next, whether a task is worth your time, what to build first, founder voice setup, and plain-English definitions of technical terms.

plugins.name: sf-strategy
plugins.description: Turn an idea into a buildable spec: translate professional expertise into a product, validate demand before building, decide whether the idea needs to be an app at all, customer and market research, niche advantage, naming and domain selection, and feature specs AI tools can execute.

plugins.name: sf-design
plugins.description: Make an AI-built SaaS look and feel professional: brand identity, UX flows, UI patterns, visual polish, motion, and a design review quality gate.

plugins.name: sf-build
plugins.description: Build and fix SaaS features with AI coding tools (Claude Code, Lovable, Replit, Cursor): tool selection, database design, integrations, LLM features, debugging, deduplication, and performance.

plugins.name: sf-ship
plugins.description: Get a SaaS app live and keep it up: testing, security, regulatory compliance, a go/no-go launch checklist, deployment, production monitoring, and analytics.

plugins.name: sf-copy
plugins.description: Write the words for a SaaS product: UI copy and CTAs, long-form founder prose, landing pages, and removing AI writing patterns so copy reads as human-written.

plugins.name: sf-seo
plugins.description: Rank in search and get cited by AI: SEO strategy and keyword planning, SEO content writing, codebase SEO audits, and technical SEO.

plugins.name: sf-channels
plugins.description: Reach people: product launches, content strategy, social media, lifecycle and branded email, paid ads, and community building for bootstrapped SaaS.

plugins.name: sf-customers
plugins.description: Win and keep customers: product-led growth, conversion optimization, retention and churn, founder-led sales, customer support, and feedback loops.

plugins.name: sf-business
plugins.description: Run the company: pricing, Stripe payments and billing, financial models and unit economics, bookkeeping and taxes, legal setup, and hiring technical help.

plugins.name: sf-dev
plugins.description: Tools for skill authors: measure whether a Claude Code skill works and improve it through A/B evaluation.
